sql.query: SELECT r.id,r.roleCode,r.roleName,r.roleDescription,r.isOwnerRole,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles targetMap WHERE targetMap.userId=:targetUserId AND targetMap.tenantId=:targetTenantId AND targetMap.roleId=r.id AND targetMap.isActive=1) isAssigned FROM tbl_roles r WHERE r.isActive=1 AND (r.tenantId=:tenantId OR (r.tenantId IS NULL AND r.isProtected=1)) AND (r.isAssignable=1 OR (r.isOwnerRole=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles ownerMap INNER JOIN tbl_roles ownerRole ON ownerRole.id=ownerMap.roleId AND ownerRole.isOwnerRole=1 AND ownerRole.isActive=1 WHERE ownerMap.userId=:ownerUserId AND ownerMap.tenantId=:ownerTenantId AND ownerMap.isActive=1))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_role_permissions targetRp WHERE targetRp.roleId=r.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles actorMap INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions actorRp ON actorRp.roleId=actorMap.roleId AND actorRp.permissionId=targetRp.permissionId WHERE actorMap.userId=:actorUserId AND actorMap.tenantId=:actorTenantId AND actorMap.isActive=1)) ORDER BY r.isOwnerRole,r.roleName
